question: Where’s the closest gallery in the direction from House of Air, San Francisco, CA to Chabot Space and Science Center, Oakland, CA?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%House of Air%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), target AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Chabot Space and Science Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Oakland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), direction_azimuth AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geometry, t.geometry)) AS bearing FROM origin o, target t ), galleries_with_distance_and_bearing AS ( SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.geometry, ST_Distance(o.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) AS distance_from_origin, degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geometry, p.geometry)) AS gallery_bearing FROM pois p, origin o WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%gallery%' -- Exclude the origin itself if it happens to be a gallery (unlikely but good practice) AND NOT ST_Equals(p.geometry, o.geometry) ) SELECT g.poi_name FROM galleries_with_distance_and_bearing g, direction_azimuth da WHERE -- Calculate the smallest angular difference between the target direction and the gallery direction LEAST( ABS(g.gallery_bearing - da.bearing), 360 - ABS(g.gallery_bearing - da.bearing) ) <= 45 -- Filter for galleries within +/- 45 degrees of the target direction ORDER BY g.distance_from_origin ASC LIMIT 1;
